slides.headline: 4 things *your warehouse* decides before an AI buys
slides.sub: AI shopping assistants check facts, not photos. 4 of them live with your 3PL.

slides.title: Stock count
slides.body: It has to be right now, not as of last night.
slides.cost: Wrong count: skipped, or cancelled after the order

slides.title: Delivery date
slides.body: A clear promise like "arrives Thursday" beats "ships in 3 to 7 days".
slides.cost: Vague dates lose to sure ones

slides.title: Return rules
slides.body: Who pays, how long it takes, and where it goes back to.
slides.cost: 1 in 3 shoppers say these rules change what they buy

slides.title: Shipping cost
slides.body: The full total at checkout, with no surprise at the end.
slides.cost: The assistant compares the total, not the tag
